asset.name: ResizableSidebar
asset.description: The sidebar with pointer and keyboard resizing, minimum and maximum constraints, double-click reset, persisted width, collapse thresholds, and content that stays usable at every width.

requires.reason: Content, sections, and active state are shared.
Resize handles, constraints, and keyboard resizing are shared.

rationale: Keyboard resizing is the part invariably skipped, and it is the difference between a resizable panel and a mouse-only one. DESIGN.md requires that opening a panel never make the workspace unusable, which is a minimum-content-width constraint rather than a sidebar maximum.
